newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France repeats break-even forecast.
newsitem.headline: Air France repeats break-even forecast.

text.p: Air France reiterated on Wednesday a forecast that it aimed to break even over the year 1996/97.

"Despite the impact of fuel costs which will be more marked in the second half, the company maintains its objective of returning to break-even for the whole of the year," the airline said in a statement with estimated first-half results.
This implied continued strict cost control and a gradual stabilisation of yields in the second half of the year, it added.
The airline earlier announced estimated first-half net profit of 802 million francs versus a net loss of 335 million a year ago.
It said the full-year result could not be extrapolated from the first half profit as the first six months were generally better due to seasonal factors.
The year-ago loss included a 295 million profit offset by a restructuring provision of 630 million.
